overview: The Medford Community Development Board reviewed three major commercial and residential proposals, granting technical waivers for a Raising Cane's drive-through, conceptually endorsing a Planned Development District on Winchester Street, and continuing the site plan review for the Great American Beer Hall.

items.title: 509-511 Riverside Avenue Site Plan Review and Special Permit (Raising Cane's)
items.summary: The board approved two technical site plan waivers for a proposed Raising Cane's drive-through restaurant at Fellsway Plaza and continued the application to May 17, 2023, while traffic and site access details are finalized with city staff.

items.title: 100 Winchester Street Planned Development District
items.summary: The board voted to conceptually endorse a Planned Development District zoning amendment for a proposed 65-unit residential building and commercial space at 96–104 Winchester Street, directing staff and the applicant to narrow the proposed table of uses prior to City Council submittal.

items.title: 142 Mystic Avenue Modified Site Plan Review (Great American Beer Hall)
items.summary: The board reviewed updated architectural, traffic, and landscape plans for the Great American Beer Hall at 142 Mystic Avenue and voted to continue the public hearing to May 3, 2023, so the applicant can submit a revised parking layout with an enhanced landscape buffer.
